description: Six LFOs summed into one complex waveform, with an optional glide on the result

params.text: Sets that oscillator's rate across the eight octaves of whichever span its RANGE switch selects
Picks the rate span for that oscillator: H runs 45Hz to 11.6kHz, L runs 0.5Hz to 116Hz, U runs 0.002Hz to 0.5Hz
Picks that oscillator's waveform, sine, saw, triangle or square, or OFF, which takes it out of the mix
Slews the summed waveform, rounding its transitions; at zero the sum passes through unslewed
Sets the curve of the slew that GLIDE applies, linear or logarithmic
Scales each of the six oscillators before they are summed
Switches the output between unipolar, running 0V to 11.2V, and bipolar, running -11.2V to 11.2V

outputs.text: The selected waveforms of the six oscillators summed, after LEVEL and GLIDE
The summed waveform with its sign reversed

menu: Add expander — offers Output expander, which places a Hyper Maniacal LFO Output Expander to the right of this module, and Megalomaniac controller expander, which places one to its left
